title: Hardcore Extra's
description: A plugin designed for adding extra options for when dying, such as lives or death bans.
body:
# Hardcore Extra's

**Hardcore Extra's** is a Minecraft plugin that enhances hardcore-style gameplay by introducing configurable death-based punishment systems.
It is designed for server owners who want greater control over how player deaths are handled while maintaining a challenging and balanced experience.

The plugin supports both permanent and temporary consequences for death, allowing it to fit a wide range of hardcore and semi-hardcore server setups.

![Header image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/817fomNv/images/9dc9036c3abb3ea6d5086574033b62b1834eed3c.png)

## Features

### Life System

The life system assigns each player a configurable number of lives when they first spawn.
For each death, it removes 1 life from their total count (this amount is also configurable).

When a player runs out of lives, they are banned from the server and can no longer play.
Players can check their remaining lives by running the `/checklives` command.

### Deathban System

The deathban system temporarily bans a player from the server when they die.
The duration of the ban is configurable in the plugin’s settings.

### Grace Period System

The grace period prevents players from receiving a penalty when they die.

When a player joins the server for the first time, the grace period is activated.
If a player dies while their grace period is still active, they will not receive the corresponding penalty.
The duration of the grace period is fully configurable. Players can check how much time remains on their grace period by running the `/checkgrace` command.

There are also options to:

* Disable PvP between players who still have their grace period active. This also applies if one player's grace period has expired while the other’s has not.
* Fully disable all player damage for those under a grace period, including fall damage, mob damage, and any other type of entity damage.

Both options are fully configurable.

## Commands

### Admin

`/hce help` - Shows the help menu

`/hce info` - Displays the current plugin configuration

`/hce reload` - Reloads all configuration files

### User Management

`/hce user unban <player>` - Unbans a player banned due to death

`/hce user setlives <player> <amount>` - Sets a player's remaining lives

`/hce user endgrace <player>` - Ends a player's grace period immediately

`/hce user reset <player>` - Resets all stored data for a player

### General Commands

`/checklives` - Displays how many lives you currently have remaining

`/checkgrace` - Shows how much time remains on your grace period
